2577-7084-8227-8345.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-7084-8227-8345.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
2577-7084-8227-8345.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

5137-6723-7008.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

222-527-1251-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1251-3899.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-2906-4247-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
586-2906-4247-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2486-4153-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

877-997-3184-4645.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing The First Sliver.
Yomiji triggers, returning The First Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider trigger.
Cast The First Sliver by paying {0}.
The First Sliver's cascade ability triggers, allowing you to cascade.
The First Sliver enters the battlefield.
Repeat.

670-1619-2438-3175-4681.easyPrerequisites: Sefris' first ability hasn't triggered this turn.
670-1619-2438-3175-4681.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in the second to last room of any dungeon.
670-1619-2438-3175-4681.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Sefris' first ability triggers, causing you to venture into the final room of a dungeon, causing you to complete the dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Sefris and Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sefris trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into the Cave Entrace room, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into either available room.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Sefris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sefris enters, Radiant Solar triggers, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into any available room.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.
670-1619-2438-3175-4681.notes: You may instead execute this combo by venturing into Tomb of Annihilation instead of Lost Mine of Phandelver.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-4762-7061.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Primal Vigor and Solid Ground.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

891-997-2730.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

969-3259-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
969-3259-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
969-3259-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Fervor so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

222-527-3967-4460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-4460.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

851-1114-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-1114-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Wrenn and Realmbreaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

967-997-1308-3809-7087.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4210-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4210-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

874-1170-1329-2059.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-2059.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Delif's Cone.
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Village Bell-Ringer.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1069-2457-5499-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-5499-6968.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

2034-3129-5220-5632-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-3129-5220-5632-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating two creature tokens and two Clue tokens
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

5078-6650-6709.easyPrerequisites:
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

632-3621-4659-5129-6791.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3621-4659-5129-6791.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

2178-2921-4681-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 4.
2178-2921-4681-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 4.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 4 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
74-617-4002.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat.

277-1479-2692-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-2692-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

198-2608-4499.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least two charge counters on it.
198-2608-4499.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

372-2187-5895.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Splash Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Possessed Skaab exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
372-2187-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

1887-2034-3305-4022-5926.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding {C}{C}.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating a token copy of each creature card in your graveyard that is a 1/1 Insect.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, the Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and the Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Hidden Herbalist trigger, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

3168-4518-4875-5613.notablePrerequisites: "Samurai" chosen with Urza's Incubator and Conspiracy.
3168-4518-4875-5613.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2092-3706-4050.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-3706-4050.description:
Activate Wren's Run Packmaster by paying {G} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Wolf, adding {G}.
Repeat.

140-2871-4258-5231.notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 3 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
140-2871-4258-5231.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {3}.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R} due to Rowan's ability, targeting any creature.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Pest, adding {R}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

228-678-862-3701.description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Crimson Kobolds.
Crimson Kobolds dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal and Skullclamp.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

488-1217-1293-1414-2232.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
488-1217-1293-1414-2232.description:
Activate Lotus Pedal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Isamaru either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W} and commander tax, if applicable.
Isamaru enters the battlefield, triggering Loran and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Yoshimaru from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Activate Lotus Pedal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Yoshimaru by paying {W}.
Yoshimaru enters the battlefield, triggering Loran and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Isamaru from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3168-4050-4242-5105.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {W}.
Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Sigil of New Dawn.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Sigil of New Dawn trigger, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Su-Chi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi by paying {1}.
Repeat.
